title: Ethereum (ETH) 📉 -2.7%

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What does Ethereum’s current dip suggest about its long-term role in the evolving crypto ecosystem?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Ethereum’s layer-2 scaling solutions like Optimism and Arbitrum are enabling faster, cheaper transactions — the infrastructure is strong.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But centralization risks in validator nodes and environmental concerns from energy use remain pressing ethical issues.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Developers are pushing for PoS upgrades and green energy partnerships to mitigate those risks and improve sustainability.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: If these efforts succeed, Ethereum could become a cornerstone of a more inclusive and environmentally responsible digital economy.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of Ethereum depends on balancing innovation with responsibility — the path is clear, but the journey is complex.
